==Usage==
For use if there are more than '''two''' {{Tl|Twoconflicting}} templates on an article.

Example:

<pre><code>
{{Twoconflicting/Multiple|[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|''The Clone Wars'': Season Seven]]|''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''|[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] and "[[Resolve (episode)|Resolve]]"}}
</code></pre>

{{Twoconflicting/Multiple|[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|''The Clone Wars'': Season Seven]]|''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''|[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] and "[[Resolve (episode)|Resolve]]"}}
